title: Data Leakage Outside RCU Read-Side Critical Section
pattern: Leaking or returning a pointer obtained inside an RCU read-side critical section to a scope outside the critical section.
why_bad: Once the RCU read lock is released, the updater is free to remove and reclaim the memory of that element. Accessing the leaked pointer outside the read lock results in a use-after-free or severe memory corruption.
detection: The return value of an RCU dereference escapes the scope of the enclosing `rcu_read_lock` and `rcu_read_unlock` pair.
counterexample: Incrementing a reference count on the object *before* releasing the RCU read lock, ensuring its existence guarantee persists.
